//rewrites: React Router owns the routing. Without this, a reload on /verify or /officer/documents/<id> asks Vercel for a file that does not exist and returns 404. Every path must serve index.html and let the router decide.
//headers: The app handles credentials and document images, so it should not be embeddable or sniffable. No CSP here on purpose: MetaMask injects into the page and a strict policy written blind would break signing. Add one only after testing a real issuance against it.

headers.//: Hashed Vite assets are immutable; index.html must never be cached or a deploy leaves users on stale JS pointing at an old API.
